investigation_focus: StepSequencer pattern application and row management

finding_1_applyPatternSet.question: How does applyPatternSet() work? What parameters does it take?
behavior: Updates currentGenreName_ and selectedGenreGuide_ from patternSet.genre
Updates genreButton_ text display
Resizes grid to match patternSet.getStepCount() if needed (calculates bars = ceiling(steps/16), clamped 1-4)
Iterates through existing grid rows
For each row: first tries to match subcategory patterns by row name (case-insensitive partial match)
If no subcategory match: matches base category using rowCategory_[row] vs patternSet.patterns map
Copies pattern.steps[0..N] to grid_[row][0..N]
Clears any roll/ratchet data for modified rows
Calls regenerateMidiFile() after all patterns applied
Calls repaint() and onPatternChanged callback
finding_1_applyPatternSet.important_note: Does NOT create new rows - only applies patterns to EXISTING rows based on category match

finding_2_addTrackRow.question: How are rows added dynamically to StepSequencer?
behavior: Creates a new row with step count matching existing grid (or cfg_.steps if empty)
Copies track.steps[0..min(16,steps)] to new row (DrumTrack internally has 16 steps)
Pushes to grid_, rowFiles_, rowLocked_, rowSoloed_, rowPatternRole_, rowCategory_, rowMidiNote_, stepRollData_
Adds track.name to cfg_.rowNames
Increments cfg_.rows
Creates and adds ChannelGenerateButton [G] for the new row
Calls regenerateMidiFile(), resized(), repaint()

finding_3_applyFlexiblePattern.question: Alternative method for applying patterns with dynamic row creation
behavior: CLEARS all existing data: grid_, rowFiles_, rowLocked_, rowSoloed_, rowPatternRole_, rowCategory_, rowMidiNote_, cfg_.rowNames
Sets tempo from pattern.tempoBpm
Creates NEW rows for each track in pattern.tracks
Copies track steps, assigns category, midiNote, name
Updates cfg_.rows
Calls regenerateMidiFile(), resized(), repaint()
finding_3_applyFlexiblePattern.key_difference: applyFlexiblePattern REPLACES all rows, applyPatternSet UPDATES existing rows

finding_7_step_sequencer_access.question: How to access the StepSequencer from other components?
finding_7_step_sequencer_access.finding: DIRECT MEMBER VARIABLE - NO EVENT BUS, NO SERVICE REGISTRY
implications: StepSequencer is owned exclusively by SampleBrowserPage
Other pages/components CANNOT directly access it
Communication must go through callbacks or adding new EventBus topics
To inject patterns from Sample Browser context menu, code must be in SampleBrowserPage

finding_10_conversion_needed.conversion_logic: Iterate result.patterns, for each entry: if isSubcategory, add to subcategoryPatterns; else add to patterns map keyed by category
